question: Does typed block/seam assembly improve independently accepted exact completions over word-at-a-time outside-in search on reserved new starts?
heldout_scope: New prospective start/scene combinations reserved before either arm runs; manually curated ordinary English drafts, not human-validated corpus spans. Existing partial/full bank is development material. No claim of globally unseen lexical tokens.
development_anchor: No rider sees red iron. remains development preference evidence; exclude from heldout outcomes.
logging: Save every proposed action with start/arm/state, source lineage, residual, syntax frontier, next-option evidence and rejection reason; retain closures rejected for grammar, coherence, known status, runtime caps and source restoration. Preserve chronological counters and timing.
primary_endpoint: Paired count of independently reviewed exact, grammatical, coherent, non-control recombinations per heldout start; unreviewed closures reported separately.
interpretation: Six starts is a feasibility pilot, not a statistical superiority or global impossibility test. No human acceptance or paragraph success inferred.
dependencies: No new paid inference/training. Existing baseline supports seeded-start wrapper must be verified before running; missing support is logged, not replaced silently.

starts.required_parse: singular animate subject + finite transitive verb + concrete NP
singular animate subject + finite transitive verb + concrete NP
singular animate subject + finite transitive verb + concrete NP
subject NP + finite transitive verb + definite object NP
subject NP + finite transitive verb + indefinite object NP
subject NP + finite transitive verb + indefinite object NP

preflight: Validate standard vocabulary membership and explicit agreement/valency parses for newly curated fragments; preserve failures.
Check starts against prior request/checkpoint start lists by normalized exact equality; any overlap excluded before execution and recorded.
Freeze bank, vocabulary, starts, scorer and exclusion hashes. No outcome-guided edits.

arms.baseline: Existing outside-in word-at-a-time search, seeded with the same fixed left/right starts; original score ordering; no old strict prohibition on individually palindromic blocks.
arms.block_seam: Existing Seam residual cancellation with full/partial bank pieces, declared syntax frontiers and one-step lexical/grammar feasibility; no native inference. Require at least two distinct source/block lineages for recombination success, excluding same-source restoration.
arms.fairness: Same lexical union, starts, target bands, exclusions, deterministic scorer and syntax/meaning review. Block vocabulary derives from exactly the same shared inventory; record scorer work and expanded states, as per-action costs differ.

budget.wall_budget: Hard monotonic check per expansion and before each cell; include index construction in 60-second search budget; preserve partial results on cap.

closure_checks: Full normalized assembled text equals its reverse under project ASCII-letter normalizer.
Explicit complete ordinary sentence parses with agreement, determiner and valency checks; independent review required for acceptance.
At least two distinct source/block lineages without duplicated complete sentences or mirror-copy padding.
Single global palindrome for any paragraph; concatenating independent palindrome sentences is not success.
Coherence checked across clauses: connected ordinary scene, consistent referents, meaningful relation. Topic overlap alone insufficient.
Exact normalized exclusion against local known catalogues, all human-identified existing controls and development bank full restorations.
Targeted archival/provenance check for each surviving full text before novelty-facing presentation; web absence never proves novelty.
